content:
The snapshot builds are still good, and not everyone has all skills leveled enough for passive cards. So this thread will never be useless! I like the easy visual I can reference.

I listed a few passive-by-default cards, but I tried to focus on general ones. This isn't really a guide, so much as me looking through my cards for skilling boosts, and hopefully not missing too many.

Mining, Chopping, Fishing, Catching, Trapping, and Worship cards can all become Passive Cards through the Rift's Skill Mastery.
Cooking, Lab, and Smithing don't have many cards, so you could keep them on a spare card set, or use Smithing cards to fill a newly vacant slot.

C.Troll is obvious, All Skill Efficiency.
Amarok and Bunny for Skill AFK.
C.Efaunt card is good for Skill Exp. Cheese Nub has Passive Skill Exp.
Crystal Capybara is great, and passive by default. Skill Efficiency.
Chocco Box for Boost Food Effect.
Various All Stat and +Base Stat cards.
HP/MP cards for snapshotting, due to Alchemy Bubbles.

Crabcake, I guess for earlygame with event boost food? Practically useless once you have other sources of non-consume. Not a lategame card, definitely.
Forest Tree and Sandy Pot improve the Exp Converter Talent, but fighting is still better for Exp.

Cooking cards aren't passive now, but it's basically just Mutated Mush (Cooking Exp) and a Passive Troll.
Gelatinous Cuboid boosts Lab Exp. Crystal Custard is Line Width Passive.
Forge cards for Smithing Exp, assuming you don't need the slots for anything else.
Card drop chance cards, for acquiring/leveling resource cards.
